title: Compact version picker + performance dossier: inline compare & pin flows
creator: Ava Chen
description: Add a compact, in-context version picker and a lightweight 'performance dossier' component to the Console that lets engineers quickly compare versions, publish performance profiles, and pin versions at route or project scope without leaving their workflow. Focus on minimizing clicks for everyday tasks: quick compare, visual P95/P50/median bars, token-cost estimates, and a single-click pin with rollback metadata. Support both single-version pin and staged rollout targets.
background: PM and several customers reported friction when onboarding new model versions: switching contexts from the model list to the detailed performance page, copying numbers into ticket text, and then returning to pin. Design explorations show users prefer inline micro-comparisons. We currently have a full performance-profile page (Console) and a separate version pin flow; this ticket consolidates a compact inline experience and ties a 'publish profile' action into the onboarding flow.
acceptance_criteria: Compact version picker component available from Model list, Model detail header, and Route edit panel
Inline performance dossier shows last-published profile metrics: P50, P95, tail latency, per-token cost estimate, quality metric (eval score) and sample prompts
Users can select up to 3 versions to compare side-by-side in the compact view
Pin action available from dossier; pin dialog supports scope (route, project, global), staged rollout (percent + steps), and required release notes field
Pin operation surfaces estimated cost delta and SLA impact before confirm
Publishing a performance profile from the dossier creates a Console audit entry and links to the model's profile history
Telemetry events emitted for open/compare/publish/pin actions (events and properties documented in dev_notes)
Accessibility: all controls keyboard navigable and labeled for screen readers
user_flows: Onboard flow: user uploads a new model version -> clicks 'Quick compare' in model header -> selects baseline and candidate -> reviews dossier -> publishes profile -> pins candidate to staging route
Route edit: developer opens route config -> clicks version picker -> compares top 2 candidates -> chooses staged rollout 10% -> confirms pin
Profile publish: engineer runs evals offline -> navigates to model -> uses 'Publish profile' from dossier to attach metadata and link to eval dashboard
dev_dependencies: ENG-4099 (pin API: POST /routes/:id/pins) - needs staged rollout support
ENG-4142 (telemetry: console.events) - new events open_dossier, compare_versions, publish_profile, confirm_pin
ENG-3988 (permissions) - ensure RBAC checks for publish and pin actions
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only flag behind feature toggle, available in staging for Redwood engineers
Beta: opt-in for selected customers and power users, collect qualitative feedback
GA: default replacement for previous modal picker; soft launch with banner and docs
Rollback: server-side kill switch for pin operations and client toggle for UI
QA_checklist: Verify metric accuracy: P50/P95 numbers match profile service and historical dashboards
Edge case: version has no published profile -> show 'No profile' state with CTA to publish
Confirm telemetry payloads include model_id, versions_compared, user_id, scope, rollout_percentage
Accessibility audit: ARIA labels, tab order, focus management within the compare panel
Permission tests for SSO/SAML orgs: publisher role vs viewer
Concurrency: confirm two simultaneous pin requests return deterministic outcome and UI handles conflicts
notes: Design tradeoffs: compact view intentionally omits long sample outputs; link to full profile page for deep dives
We want to prioritize latency metrics and cost delta visible up-front to reduce bad pins that cause surprise costs
Consider a 'fast compare' mode that fetches cached profiles first and then updates with fresh stats
If the profile was generated >30 days ago, show a staleness badge and recommend re-eval
